title: Nuqṭa ('On the Dot')
genre: commentary on a saying of ʿAlī

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 124b-26a), flagged with his asterisk as probably a date of transcription rather than composition (p.79).

addressee: An unnamed friend, to whom it was a response
occasion: Written in response to a friend.
manuscript: 16 items listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 124b-26a (16 Ramaḍān 828/1 Aug 1425); then MS 5423 (842/1439), Bijapur MS Arabic BIJ 1238/3 (869-71/1465-67), Bāqir Riqqat majmūʿa (901/1496), and later copies; also misattributed to Davānī.
summary: A commentary on ʿAlī's saying 'I am the dot beneath the B', written in response to a friend; wrongly attributed in one publication to Jalāl al-Dīn Davānī.
